title: symmc-flow v3: preregistered benchmark of molecular-crystal orientation completion (code, protocol, refcode lists, results)
description:
Code, preregistered protocol and results for the N3 benchmark of molecular-crystal orientation completion (ACS Omega resubmission, manuscript ao-2026-09173w). For crystals with one molecule in the asymmetric unit, the true lattice, space-group operations, asymmetric-unit centroid and rigid conformer are given and the asymmetric-unit orientation is predicted; this is not crystal structure prediction.

Contents: the preregistered protocol and its amendments (tasks/n3_protocol.md), the frozen model selection (results/n3/n3_selection.json), the refcode lists that define every set (tasks/n3_sets/), the numeric results committed before interpretation (results/n3/n3_results.json), the scoring and arm code (scripts/n3_*.py), the scripts that generate every number and table of the manuscript and Supporting Information (scripts/n3_paper_numbers.py, scripts/n3_si_tables.py), and the manuscript sources.

Cambridge Structural Database structures are licence-restricted and are not included; the refcode lists reproduce every set from a licensed CSD installation.
